title: Pin admission regression pause ownership independently of the product predicate
outcome: The lost-bind and lost-evaluate OFF regression has independent absolute pause-ownership expectations, so a classification regression cannot make both implementation and expected result change together.
acceptance: For both session_bind and turn_evaluate cases, human_prompt_ui_resume_preserves_retained_gated_admission_recovery independently asserts the expected pre-OFF paused and control-owned values before its relative transition assertion.
The exact head, frozen request, ledger, interruption, no-provider/no-control-RPC and ON exact recovery checks remain; diagnostics are deliberately retained or removed with rationale.
Focused verification covers both lost-operation branches and an independent review confirms the new assertions do not derive their expectation from control_pause_is_owned.
disposal_reason: Obsolete assertion refinement for deleted gated admission test and predicate: native rg over current src finds no human_prompt_ui_resume_preserves_retained_gated_admission_recovery or control_pause_is_owned. Current product no longer has ON admission/lost-bind/evaluate transition being pinned. Cancel as inapplicable under Fable2694/Greg direction, not as tested/fixed; original4133967c review evidence retained and no replacement phrase/implementation-mirroring test added.
